title: Encryption process spreading from a compromised laptop across peer connections toward payroll computers
summary: A compromised laptop's encryption process copied itself to three peer machines over direct peer-to-peer connections. Those connections can reach two uninfected payroll computers. One-at-a-time host inspection and cleaning did not outpace the spread, and no response action has been approved.

constraints: No response action has yet been approved.
failed_predictions: host-by-host cleanup would be faster than the spread

roles.infected_laptop: The compromised employee laptop from which the encryption process copied itself.
roles.peer_machines: The three peer employee machines to which the encryption process copied itself.
roles.payroll_computers: The two still-uninfected computers that run payroll and are reachable through the same peer connections.
